theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The leader sits at rank 1 with the strongest score, eligible under the absolute-trend gate, breadth 0.75 (broad participation, not a one-name story), and not crowded (z=0.53). This is a continuation lean on an intact, broad trend — the detector's only validated edge is trend-gate risk control, which is satisfied here.

The rotation margin vs the leader is 0.595, which is not a confirmed handoff — it is a durable co-leader in the same semis/AI buildout cluster. Lean with the broad, eligible trend rather than the single name.
evidence: rotation margin 0.595 vs leader (no confirmed handoff)
theses.dissent: High overlap with Memory/HBM via the same SMH proxy means this may be the same trade twice; if the AI-infra capex narrative stalls (hyperscaler guidance cut), both leaders fade together.

falsifier.text: AI Infrastructure breadth falls below 0.5 while its score slips below the rank-5 threshold even as the gate stays eligible

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Rank 3, eligible, with the strongest breadth (0.9) and a clean 'trend' Hurst tag — high participation and persistent trend health. However it is crowded (z=1.82), which is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, not a fade. The lean is continuation on trend health, with the crowding flag tempering any enthusiasm.
